tasks.title: 馃殌 Onboarding Guide 鈥?Set Up Mission Control
tasks.description:
Welcome to Mission Control! Follow these steps to complete your setup. Work through each subtask in order.

**Tip:** Click on a subtask to see detailed instructions. Check it off when done.

subtasks.title: 1. Enable GitHub Pages: Settings 鈫?Pages 鈫?Branch: main 鈫?Save
2. Create GitHub Token: github.com/settings/tokens 鈫?Generate (classic) 鈫?Scope: repo
3. Connect Dashboard: Open your GitHub Pages URL 鈫?Click 'Connect GitHub' 鈫?Paste token
4. Install Tailscale: brew install tailscale && tailscale up
5. Enable Funnel: tailscale funnel 18789 鈫?Copy your URL
6. Generate Webhook Token: openssl rand -hex 32 鈫?Save it
7. Add GitHub Webhook: Settings 鈫?Webhooks 鈫?Add 鈫?URL: https://YOUR-TAILSCALE-URL/hooks/github?token=YOUR-TOKEN
8. Test: Create a task, move to In Progress, verify MoltBot receives notification

comments.author: Mission Control
comments.text: Once all steps are complete, you can archive this guide or keep it as reference. Your setup is done when MoltBot responds to task changes!

tasks.title: 馃摉 User Guide 鈥?How to Use Mission Control
tasks.description:
Learn how to use Mission Control effectively. Both you AND MoltBot can manage tasks!

**Two ways to manage tasks:**
鈥?馃懁 **You** 鈥?Use the Dashboard UI (drag & drop, buttons, forms)
鈥?馃 **MoltBot** 鈥?Uses CLI scripts or edits tasks.json directly

title.title: Columns: Permanent (recurring) 鈫?Backlog 鈫?In Progress 鈫?Review 鈫?Done
Drag & Drop: Move tasks between columns to change status
Click task card to open details and edit
鈥?CREATING TASKS 鈥?,
馃懁 You: Click '+' button in any column header
馃 MoltBot: Edits data/tasks.json or uses CLI
鈥?TASK DETAILS 鈥?,
Title: Short, clear name for the task
Description: Detailed instructions (Markdown supported)
Subtasks: Break work into smaller steps (checkable)
Comments: Add notes, feedback, or progress updates
Priority: High (馃敶) / Medium (馃煛) / Low (馃煝)
Project: Organize tasks by project/category
鈥?WORKFLOW WITH MOLTBOT 鈥?,
1. Create task in Backlog with clear description
2. Move to 'In Progress' 鈫?MoltBot gets notified via webhook
3. MoltBot works on task, updates subtasks & adds comments
4. MoltBot moves to 'Review' when done
5. You review: Approve 鈫?Done, or add feedback 鈫?back to In Progress
鈥?DASHBOARD FEATURES 鈥?,
馃攳 Search: Filter tasks by text
馃搧 Project filter: Click project buttons to filter
鈿欙笍 Settings: Add/edit projects
馃摝 Archive: Store completed tasks out of sight
馃懃 Team: See repo collaborators (if public)
馃摎 Docs: Built-in documentation
鈥?MOLTBOT CAPABILITIES 鈥?,
馃 Can CREATE tasks (via CLI or JSON)
馃 Can UPDATE task status, subtasks, comments
馃 Can MOVE tasks between columns
馃 Can DELETE/archive tasks
馃 Receives WEBHOOK when you move tasks to In Progress

comments.text: This guide stays in Permanent so you can always reference it. The subtasks aren't meant to be 'completed' 鈥?they're documentation!

title.description:
This is an example of what a real task looks like. Feel free to edit or delete it.

**Good task descriptions include:**
- What needs to be done
- Why it matters
- Any constraints or requirements
- Links to relevant resources
